text: The ear specialist was very professional, approachable and spoke excellent English. She completely cured a serious ear infection i had picked up while in Thailand. I would heartily recommend.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text: The otorhinolaryngology was very friendly and provided an extremely helpful treatment, would definitely recommend!

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text:
Very good experience with the doctor, as confirmed by previous reviews.

Unfortunately, in my case, there was a long wait of 2.5 hours, as all the Thai patients arriving gradually were seen first. I don't want to judge this too harshly, as the treatment itself was more important to me.

It's worth arriving early. The opening hours on the day I went were from 12 pm to 1 pm, and shortly before 12 pm, the waiting room was already overcrowded with 20 people. You could still come until shortly after 1 pm, after which no new patients were accepted. I was seen around 2:30 pm, meaning the treatment time extended well beyond the opening hours.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text:
A very good experience. The doctor is very kind and reassuring and explains things very well in English. I highly recommend her.

For foreigners: I understand that it's a walk-in clinic, open from 12:00 to 13:00 and from 16:30 to 17:30, but before opening time there's a waiting list on the door where you have to write your name. When I arrived at 10:30 in the morning, there were already six people on the list ahead of me. But I didn't have to wait long.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text: Great service. The doctor answered honestly, spoke perfect English, and was highly knowledgeable. She cleaned my ears thoroughly, painlessly, and quickly. She also gave me medication for an ear infection. She assured me the medication was safe and explained everything thoroughly. I recommend her to everyone.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text:
My son developed an ear infection and was referred to this clinic by a large hospital in Krabi. Since our return flight was approaching, the doctor was very kind and helpful, offering lots of advice!

They even used Google Translate to explain complex things, and I'm so grateful for their gentle and understanding approach.

Thanks to the doctor, we were able to return home safely.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหูคอจมูก กระดูกและข้อ หมอปุณณดา - หมออาทินันทน์
text: The doctor was so lovely! She explained everything in detail, provided valuable knowledge for better understanding, shared self-care tips, and offered great encouragement. Her cheerful disposition made my sick vacation in Krabi far from sad. Love you, doctor! ❤️

text: I used a map to find this place, and it was my first time. The waiting area was comfortable, with air conditioning and fans for ventilation. The counter staff were polite, helpful, and provided excellent advice. The doctor was also very helpful, friendly, and clarified all my questions. There was no rush at all; I was the last patient in line. I highly recommend this place. The prices are very reasonable and the atmosphere is very friendly. Everything was explained in detail.
